name: SafeDollar reward pool deflationary-token accounting
summary: SdoRewardPool listed PLX, whose transfers charge the sender a fee on top, yet repaid deposits at face value and derived rewards per share from its live PLX balance. After staking PLX, the attacker deposited and withdrew 101 times per transaction so the pool paid the fees from other stakers' PLX down to 2 wei; the inflated index minted SDO, dumped for the SDO pairs' USDC and USDT.
notes: Reset: add() listing PLX as pool 9 (poolLength 9 to 10) created the vulnerable pool; later owner calls touched other pools, and PLX's own proxy upgrade four days before only added an ERC1820 toggle, not the fee behaviour.

The two drain transactions took other stakers' PLX from the pool as burns and fees; DefiLlama has no PLX price and the attacker realised nothing from it, so it is listed at zero (about 1.5k USD at pair prices).
Other pool-9 stakers later harvested inflated SDO too, but the SDO pairs held only about 60 USD after the attacker's dump, so those harvests are not listed.
